tools.name: get_trouble_code
tools.description: What an OBD-II trouble code means in plain words, what the engine computer saw, what the code does not prove, what gets checked first and the related codes. One code, for example P0420.

tools.name: list_trouble_codes
tools.description: Every OBD-II trouble code Oil & Miles has a page on, each with its short meaning and page link.

tools.name: get_coolant_spec
tools.description: The coolant a car's owner's manual names, by make, model and model year, and the manual it comes from. Make is required; leave model or year out to list more cars.

tools.name: list_repair_cost_jobs
tools.description: The repair jobs that have per-car cost ranges, with the number of cars and the page link.

tools.name: get_repair_cost
tools.description: Parts and labor cost ranges for one repair job, per car, at an independent shop and at a dealer, in US dollars, as the page shows them. Each car has its own range; never combine ranges across cars.

tools.name: find_warranty_coverage
tools.description: Carmaker warranty extensions and special coverage programs for a make, optionally narrowed by model and model year: what is covered, for how long and where the page explains it.
